'''Elvira Martuuk''' is a ship Engineer based at '''Long Sight Base''' in the '''Khun''' system. An explorer with a specialist interest in propulsion and shields, she is an independent entry point into ship [[Engineering]]: no referral from [[Felicity Farseer]] or another Engineer is required before a Commander can meet her.<ref name="inara-elvira">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/2/ Elvira Martuuk — Engineer], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref><ref name="edwiki-elvira">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Elvira_Martuuk Elvira Martuuk], Elite Dangerous Wiki. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

Her highest-grade service is '''Grade 5 Frame Shift Drive engineering'''. She also works on Shield Generators, Thrusters, and Shield Cell Banks at lower maximum grades.<ref name="inara-elvira" />

== Location ==

* '''System:''' Khun
* '''Facility:''' Long Sight Base
* '''Engineer scope:''' Ship modules
* '''Referral required:''' None

Long Sight Base provides the Engineer workshop and Universal Cartographics access used to build reputation with Elvira.

== Access requirements ==

Elvira's whereabouts are public knowledge. Access requires three direct conditions:<ref name="inara-elvira" />

# Reach a maximum distance of at least '''300 light-years from the Commander's career start location'''.
# Carry '''3 units of Soontill Relics''' to Long Sight Base.
# Donate all three units to Elvira.

The distance requirement uses the greatest distance reached from the career start location; it is not a cumulative total of hyperspace travel.

Soontill Relics are rare commodities rather than Raw, Manufactured, or Encoded Engineering materials. The three units require cargo space and must reach the workshop aboard the visiting ship.

For acquisition advice, route planning, and the complete ordered process, see [[Unlocking Elvira Martuuk]].

{{Field note|Elvira and Felicity Farseer are separate starting Engineers. Unlocking one is not a prerequisite for the other.}}

== Workshop reputation ==

Reputation with Elvira increases by:<ref name="inara-elvira" />

* crafting modifications at her workshop; or
* selling exploration data at Long Sight Base.

Higher reputation opens the grades that Elvira supports. Exploration data gathered while meeting the 300-light-year distance requirement can be sold at Long Sight Base after access is available.

== Engineering services ==

The maximum grade is specific to each module family. Elvira's Grade 5 maximum applies only to the Frame Shift Drive.<ref name="inara-elvira" /><ref name="edwiki-elvira" />

{| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;"
! Module
! Maximum grade
|-
| [[Frame Shift Drive]]
| '''Grade 5'''
|-
| [[Shield Generator]]
| '''Grade 3'''
|-
| [[Thrusters]]
| '''Grade 2'''
|-
| [[Shield Cell Bank]]
| '''Grade 1'''
|}

The available modification families, effects, trade-offs, and recipes belong to [[Engineering Blueprints]]. Compatible secondary modifications belong to [[Experimental Effects]]. Elvira can apply compatible Experimental Effects to module families that she engineers even when her maximum blueprint grade for that family is below the grade already installed on a module.

== Blueprint pinning and remote work ==

After sufficient reputation has been earned, one Elvira blueprint can be pinned for use through [[Remote Engineering]]. Pinning does not change the grade that Elvira offers and does not make Experimental Effects available remotely. Blueprint choice depends on the Commander's ships and on blueprints already pinned with other Engineers.

== Direct referrals ==

Elvira directly introduces three Engineers after the Commander reaches Grade 3 access and progresses approximately one-third of the way toward Grade 4 with her:<ref name="inara-marco">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/7/ Marco Qwent — Engineer], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref><ref name="inara-nemo">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/9/ Zacariah Nemo — Engineer], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref><ref name="inara-mel">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/22/ Mel Brandon — Engineer], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

* '''[[Marco Qwent]]''' in Sirius
* '''[[Zacariah Nemo]]''' in Yoru
* '''[[Mel Brandon]]''' in the Colonia region

Each referral reveals an Engineer; it does not satisfy that Engineer's own invitation or unlock requirements. Their locations, requirements, services, and later referrals belong to their individual articles. For the complete network, see [[Engineer Unlock Guide]].
